settings.heading: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What is your return/exchange policy?
settings.row_content:
You may return or exchange your product within 30 days of purchase. We are extending the return window to 60 days, for order placed from 11/20 through 12/31.

For exchanges, your new product will ship out upon receipt of your return at any UPS drop-off location. To ensure inventory for your exchange, we recommend timely drop-off.

  • We cover all return fees for exchanges  
  • Exchanges can be dropped off any UPS drop off location
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable
  • Exchanges are only offered in the contiguous United States
  • Products purchased from authorized retailers (not on kswiss.com) must be returned to the original retailer and are subject to their return policy

For returns, our warehouse will begin the refund process upon receipt of your return. Refunds typically take 7 - 14 business days (up to 21 business days during Holiday).

  • We charge $0 return fee to cover shipping and processing fees.
  • You will receive a prepaid shipping label to return your unwanted item(s).
  • Original shipping costs are non-refundable
  • Returns are only offered in the contiguous United States
  • Products purchased from authorized retailers (not on kwiss.com) must be returned to the original retailer and are subject to their return policy

START MY RETURN

settings.heading: How do I return my order?
settings.row_content:
We offer a very easy way to make your K-Swiss.com return:

Return by Prepaid Shipping Label: 

Enter your order number and email to begin and follow the step-by-step instructions. You do not need to have an account or login to use the Returns Center.

Place your items plus your packing slip in the original reusable shipping carton (or packaging of your choice), affix the prepaid return label to the outside of the package.

Drop off your package at any UPS office, UPS partner location or a Walgreens near you.

START YOUR RETURN 


Rturn Instructions   

Place your items along with the packing slip in the original reusable shipping carton (or packaging of your choice). Print the prepaid return label that was sent to your email, then affix it to the outside of the package. Please note that we do not provide physical return labels.

settings.heading: What is a Final Sale item?
settings.row_content:
An item is considered FINAL SALE when it is purchased at a discount of more than 50% off its original price. This applies regardless of whether the item is explicitly labeled "Final Sale" at the time of purchase.

Please carefully review the discount and product details before completing your purchase, as all qualifying Final Sale purchases are considered final.

settings.heading: Can I return a Final Sale item?
settings.row_content: No, Final Sale items are not eligible for return, refund, or exchange.

settings.heading: How soon will I receive my refund?
settings.row_content:
We will process your refund within 7-14 business days after receiving your return and processing it in our warehouse. Refunds will be issued in the original form of payment. If the refund is applied to your credit card, your credit card company may take up to 10 additional business days to post the refund to your account. 

During the holiday season (December-February), returns may take up to 21 business days to process due to higher than normal sales volume.

settings.heading: How much does it cost to return my order?
settings.row_content:
Returns are free.

Original shipping and handling fees are non-refundable.

settings.heading: Returning a PayPal order?
settings.row_content: PayPal orders returned online will be refunded in the original form of payment.

settings.heading: Can I exchange my order?
settings.row_content: You may return or exchange your product within 30 days of purchase. We are extending the return/exchange window to 60 days, for order placed from 11/20 through 12/31.

settings.heading: What if my online order arrived defective or damaged?
settings.row_content:
If you receive a damaged or defective item that was ordered from kswiss.com, please visit our Contact Us Page so send us any information with photos and a brief description of the issue, and we will work with you on issuing a replacement for the defective pair (provided we hear from you before an item has sold out).

Additionally, we will cover any manufacturer defects up to 90 days after the original purchase date. If you believe the item you received is defective, please reach out to our customer service team with photos of the shoe in question on our Contact Us Page.

Note that each defective shoe will be analyzed in a case by case basis, and we cannot guarantee that your shoe will be replaced upon sending photos to our team.

Before contacting Customer Service, please be prepared with your order number. You can find your order number by logging in to your kswiss.com account or referencing your original confirmation email.

settings.heading: RETURNS & EXCHANGES
When will I receive my purchase?
settings.row_content: Please see Shipping Policy HERE.

settings.heading: How will I know when my order has shipped?
settings.row_content:
After you place your order, you will receive e-mails about your order. Below are the kinds of e-mails you might receive:

Order Confirmation: This e-mail confirms that we have received your order. It includes your order number. Keep this e-mail for your records.

Shipment Confirmation: This e-mail confirms that your order or part of your order has shipped.

Important notice about your order: There are a few reasons why you would receive this e-mail, including: difficulty in processing your order, inability to ship to the address provided, duplicate order, or cancellation of order.

Note: K-Swiss explicitly reserves the right not to accept your order and to cancel the Purchase.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?
settings.row_content:
Check the status of your most recent orders by visiting the your Order Details page (may require you to be logged in).

This is the easiest and fastest way to get the most current information regarding your K-Swiss web shop orders. An order summary page will provide you with detailed information about your current order or past orders. After your order is shipped, your tracking number, if available, will be displayed.

settings.heading: SHIPPING
Is Worry-Free Delivery Necessary?
settings.row_content:
Worry-Free Delivery is an optional extra that helps protect your order in case it gets lost, stolen, or damaged during shipping.

You’re welcome to remove it from your cart at checkout if you decide you don’t need it.

settings.heading: Can I Cancel My Worry-Free Delivery If It Was Added by Mistake?
settings.row_content:
Yes. If Worry-Free Delivery protection was inadvertently included in your order, you may request a cancellation within a limited time window.

Important Purchase Rules

✅ Must be purchased at checkout — cannot be added after shipment.

✅ Coverage becomes effective at the time of shipment. Worry-Free Delivery fees are non-refundable after the effective date.

✅ Cancellation is only available before shipment.

settings.heading: What Does Seel Worry-Free Delivery Cover?
settings.row_content:
Damaged Items

Items damaged to the point of being unusable—such as fractured, shattered, bent, or crushed products—are covered up to the full item value paid.

Please note that cosmetic damage, including scratches or dents, is not covered. Compensation may vary depending on the severity of the damage.

Lost Packages

A package is considered lost if it has not been delivered within:

  • 10 days of order fulfillment for domestic orders
  • 30 days of order fulfillment for international orders

Lost packages are compensated for the full item value paid.

Delayed Packages

A package is considered delayed if it has not arrived within:

  • 10 days of order fulfillment for domestic orders
  • 30 days of order fulfillment for international orders

Compensation for delays is $5 USD (or the equivalent amount in your transaction currency—for example, €5 for euro-denominated orders). The exact amount may vary by merchant.

Porch Piracy / Theft

If your tracking status shows "Delivered" but you did not receive your package, the issue may qualify as a porch piracy claim.

Additional documentation may be required to verify the claim.

settings.heading: How to Report an Issue
settings.row_content:
You can easily submit a claim through the Seel Resolution Center.

Before submitting your claim, please have the following information available:

  • The email address used to place the order
  • Your order number

Please report your issue within the following timeframes:

Loss (package not delivered per carrier) = Within 90 days of the order date

Damage or theft (package marked "Delivered")= Within 7 days of the "Delivered" status update

All other issues = Within 90 days of the order date

What's Not Covered

The following situations are excluded from coverage:

Intentional acts, fraud, or criminal acts by delivery personnel or users

Refusal or failure to sign for a delivery

Issues based on false or fabricated tracking information

Delays or losses caused by war, armed conflict, strikes, riots, or terrorism

Delays or losses caused by natural disasters (including earthquakes, floods, typhoons, and similar events)

settings.heading: When Will I Receive My Worry-Free Delivery Payout?
settings.row_content:
Once your claim has been reviewed and approved, you will be prompted to select your preferred payout method.

Estimated processing times are as follows:

Bank Transfer
Funds typically arrive within 1–3 business days after claim approval.

PayPal
Funds are usually transferred within 24–48 hours after claim approval.

settings.heading: WORRY-FREE DELIVERY
Am I able to work with a representative to place an order?
settings.row_content:
We understand that some consumers may have questions in the process of navigating the website and or entering their order. At this time, we are more than happy to assist you with any questions you may have about styles, fit or general questions. However, we are unable to place orders for customers over the phone or via email. 

Should you need help, please feel free to contact your our customer service center via our Contact Us page.

settings.heading: How do I use my Discount/Promo Code?
settings.row_content:
We do occasionally offer promotional or discount codes.

Unless otherwise stated, these codes will work on Full Priced items excluding Court Performance product and special collaborations. Codes will sometimes be valid on already discounted items. 

You can apply your discount code from your shopping cart. 

Codes will not be honored past the advertised expiration date. Codes are only valid on advertised product and in the region in which it is advertised. We reserve the right to not honor any code that was not distributed through our own advertising (email, social, etc.) and orders may be cancelled if a code is misused.

To be in the loop on these promotions, we advise that you sign up for our email newsletter on the homepage, or follow us on social media.

settings.heading: I live outside the US. How can I place an order?
settings.row_content: Unfortunately, at this time, we do not offer international shipping from the United States. Please refer to independent retailers in your area for available products.

settings.heading: How can I cancel my order?
settings.row_content: If you need to cancel your order, please follow the link on your order confirmation within 15 minutes of placing your order.  We will not be able to cancel your order after this time frame.  We apologize for any inconvenience.

settings.heading: My order was cancelled.
settings.row_content:
Occasionally, orders or parts of an order are cancelled by our system for various reasons. Some reasons are:

- Item(s) not available.

- Difficulty in processing your payment information.

- Cannot ship to address provided.

- Duplicate order was placed.

- Cancelled due to a customer request.

If your order is cancelled, you will receive a notice regarding your order via e-mail which will explain the reason for the cancellation. You will not be billed for any cancelled items.

settings.heading: ORDERING
What is a K-Swiss E-Gift Card?
settings.row_content:
It’s the perfect gift for everyone on your list and acts like a debit card. Just choose the amount and the recipient can redeem it for whatever they wish in the amount you specified (up to $200). If you’d like to treat them to something special that’s over $200, please email us at  kscs@k-swiss.com.

Gift cards can be used at kswiss.com. Select the gift you’re interested in and use your gift card to pay for it. The gift card keeps track of the balance, so you can use it on one purchase and then use it again on another with the remaining balance.

settings.heading: How do I receive my E-Gift Card?
settings.row_content: Your e-gift card will be sent to your email address. If you wish to send it to a loved one as a gift, just forward them the email that was sent to you with the e-gift card code.

settings.heading: How can I redeem my K-Swiss Gift Card?
settings.row_content:
Gift cards can be used at kswiss.com.

REDEEMING YOUR GIFT CARD ONLINE:

• During checkout , enter your gift card code on the checkout page.
• Click "Apply"
• Once applied, click "Continue".

Please note: If you still have balance remaining on your order, you may select a credit card or Paypal to cover the remaining balance.

If the total cost of the merchandise is less than the amount on your gift card, your order will be processed and the balance will remain on the card so you can use it again.

settings.heading: Can I reload my K-Swiss Gift Card?
settings.row_content: Currently we do not have this functionality on our site but it’s on the way. We are always trying to improve our site to best serve our customers.

settings.heading: Are there shipping charges on Gift Cards?
settings.row_content: There are no shipping cost of the K-Swiss e-gift cards.
